metadata.title: Forklift Incident
metadata.description: A pedestrian has been struck by a forklift in a warehouse aisle. As shift supervisor, secure the scene, summon medical help without moving the victim, escalate, preserve evidence, and file the report — by voice.

scoringRules.notes: Deterministic sum of transition scoreDeltas. Weight table (required, golden path): secure_scene 12 + call_emergency 11 + notify_supervisor 9 + preserve_scene 10 + document_incident 15 = 57. Denominator 57 is the max over strict-progress paths (no self-loop stays, no repeats) — the minimal required safe sequence. Optional self-loop bonuses (early call/notify, brief_operator up to +4, check_witnesses up to +3, confirm_certification up to +2, reassess +2/+3, correct_course +2) are extra credit beyond the denominator; the theoretical ceiling (computeMaxScore, each positive self-loop taken at most once) reflects those safe extras. Invalid self-loops carry penalties (move_victim -12 spinal risk, restart_forklift -10, clear_aisle -8, handle_alone -6) with no state change. Golden five-turn path scores 57/57 (perfect required). Unlike Warehouse (which needs a separate documented state + cleanup step), filing the report closes this drill, so the documented flag lands on the resolved transition and no separate documented state is needed.
